description: Election Commission : Filling of vacancies of members of Chavakachcheri UC, Rathnapura MC, Wanathawilluwa and Akmeemana Pradeshiya Sabhas
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government councils (Urban Council, Pradeshiya Sabha, Municipal Council) due to resignations or death, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, specifically the nomination and declaration of new members to replace those who vacated their seats, which falls under election-related matters.
